274900816.description:
Vintage Desk Pen Set Lot
Parker, Cross, and Reflections Clock Sets
3 Items, Mid-Century to Late 20th Century
This collection of vintage executive desk sets offers a variety of materials and styles suitable for professional offices or home libraries. The lot includes a classic Parker set on a black polished base, a functional Reflections clock and twin pen set, and a substantial natural stone base by Cross. These pieces represent the high standard of desktop accessories from the mid-to-late 20th century, combining utility with decorative presence.
ITEMS INCLUDED:
1.
Parker Desk Set
- Polished black glass or stone base with twin black sockets and gold-tone Parker branding.
2.
Reflections Clock Desk Set
- Mahogany-tone base with center quartz clock and two matching gold-tone ballpoint pens.
3.
Cross Onyx Desk Set
- Substantial natural creamy onyx base with single black socket; features original Cross manufacturer label on underside.
Condition:
Overall fair to good vintage condition. The Parker base shows visible adhesive residue or finish wear around the brass socket mounts. The Reflections clock set includes an engraved presentation plate for "Virginia Counter"; quartz clock functionality is not confirmed. The Cross onyx base is missing its second socket, leaving an empty brass sleeve. General surface wear, dust, and light scratching consistent with age and use across all pieces.
